verdict.rationale: A community user lists 'multivariate flags' as a key LaunchDarkly benefit, which supports the core of the story. The first-party 'Create flags' doc appears only as a title, with no detail on flag variation types. missing for 10: first-party documentation of string, number and JSON flag variation types; evidence of serving dynamic configuration values through the SDKs; hands-on corroboration beyond a single community mention.
